sub_indicators.label: Use of digital ID in other systems
sub_indicators.subject: dpi.exchange
sub_indicators.text: Use of digital id in other systems: use of digital id in other systems
sub_indicators.norm_short: The African Union's interoperability framework and the AfCFTA Digital Trade Protocol ask that a national digital ID be the credential other public and private services rely on, recognised across borders.
criteria: A source from the past three years says no other system checks people against the national ID.
Another system's use of the national ID is contracted, being built or piloted: a SIM-registration link, a bank's KYC check, a social programme's enrolment.
A service in use checks people against the national ID: SIM registration, a bank's or mobile money provider's KYC, a social programme, health insurance.
Services in two or more sectors check people against the national ID, shown by sources from the past three years.
A source from the past three years gives a figure for verifications made against the ID, or counts the services relying on it.
